text:
incident-bot: ALERT — elevated pod imagePullBackOff rate across multiple clusters (k8s-autoscale-*) detected at 2026-03-15T21:24:16Z. paging @eng-oncall and @infra-eng. automated threshold: 120 failures / 5m

eng-oncall (sam): I’m on it, acknowledging. Which clusters are seeing the most failures? any customer-facing apps impacted yet?

infra-eng (kyle): seeing failures on eu-prod and us-west-worker pools. bootstrap logs show docker.io returning 403/ratelimit errors when pulling nvidia/cuda:11.8-cudnn. sample kubelet log:```
Mar 15 21:22:01 kubelet: pull image "docker.io/nvidia/cuda:11.8-cudnn" failed: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = failed to pull and unpack image "docker.io/...": received unexpected status 429 Too Many Requests
```

deploy-bot: Autoscaler event: scaled up nodegroup "ng-gpu-latest" x3 at 21:21:50 — new nodes failing to finish bootstrap due to image pulls.

cloud-ops (nathan): Docker Hub is reporting elevated rate limiting for unauthenticated pulls in the wild; also seeing increased latency from the nvidia/cuda repo. Could be a Docker Hub-side spike or an upstream mirror issue.

sre (jess): Customer impact assessment: user-facing services already warm are fine. New rollout jobs and auto-scaled GPU workloads may be delayed/fail; expected impact: degraded scaling for MLE teams and batch jobs — potential S3 (partial degradation) until mitigated.

support-ops (monica): Support: please confirm which customers have active GPU autoscaling quotas we should notify. Drafting a status message once we have ETA.

eng-oncall (sam): Mitigation plan: 1) start internal mirror/pre-pull into our ECR mirror for the affected tags 2) change kube-provisioner imagePullPolicy to IfNotPresent for GPU node init 3) temporarily pin node pool to nodes with cached images 4) if needed, fallback to alternate registry (ghcr/gcr) or smaller base image.

infra-eng (kyle): kicking off mirror job now — pulling tags: `nvidia/cuda:11.8-cudnn`, `nvidia/cuda:11.8-runtime`. I created a short Job to populate our ecr-cache repo:```yaml
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: mirror-nvidia-cuda-11-8
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: mirror
        image: registry.tools/internal-mirror:latest
        args: ["pull", "docker.io/nvidia/cuda:11.8-cudnn", "push", "our-ecr/nvidia/cuda:11.8-cudnn"]
      restartPolicy: Never
```
Applying to clusters with `kubectl --context=eu-prod apply -f mirror-job.yaml`

eng-oncall (sam): Started a DaemonSet to pre-pull the image onto existing nodes in the pool so new nodes can use cached layers:```
kubectl apply -f gs/prepull-daemonset.yaml --context=us-west-worker
```

cloud-ops (nathan): Also toggled node bootstrap to use imagePullSecrets for authenticated pulls from Docker Hub (our rate limit window is higher when authenticated). Command run:```
kubectl create secret docker-registry dockerhub-auth --docker-username=${DOCKERHUB_USER} --docker-password=${DOCKERHUB_TOKEN} -n kube-system
kubectl patch serviceaccount node-bootstrap -n kube-system -p '{"imagePullSecrets": [{"name": "dockerhub-auth"}]}'
```

support-ops (monica): Draft status update (please approve):
"We are investigating provisioning delays caused by third-party registry throttling affecting NVIDIA CUDA images. Workarounds in progress: switching to our internal image mirror, pre-pulling images to nodes, and using authenticated pulls. Some GPU job startups may be delayed. ETA: 30-60 minutes. Updates: <https://status.redwood.example/incident/INC-20260315-17>"

eng-oncall (sam): approved. post to status page and to customers on the affected list. @support-ops please include link to the ticket once created.

prod-status-bot: Incident INC-20260315-17 created (sev: S3) — incident channel: #inc-20260315-17 — commander: sam — started 2026-03-15T21:28:00Z

infra-eng (kyle): mirror job progress: 20% across eu-prod, 35% us-west; pulling is slower than usual but working. Pre-pull DS started on 4/6 nodes in us-west.

sre (jess): Logging/alerts: temporarily suppressed repeated imagePullBackOff alert flood and created a derived metric to track unique failing nodes to avoid noise. Keep error logs for postmortem.

eng-oncall (sam): Handoff note: I need to step away in 15m. handing off to @sre (jess) for the next 2h. Jess, please monitor mirror progress and watch for new scale events.

sre (jess): taking over, ack. I'll maintain comms with cloud-ops and support.

support-ops (monica): Notified 7 customers with active GPU clusters (email + in-app). Template used: "We're aware of provisioning delays due to third-party registry throttling; our mitigation is in progress."

cloud-ops (nathan): If internal mirror doesn't finish in 45m, plan B: switch k8s node bootstrap to pull a smaller, equivalent runtime image we already have in our internal repo, and allow teams to retry workloads. Preparing patch now.

eng-oncall (sam): Good. Add follow-ups for post-incident: - evaluate long-term cache strategy (warm nodes, ECR mirror retention) - review node bootstrap ordering so kubelet can fallback to alternate registry - add synthetic checks for image pull latency on nvidia/cuda tags.

infra-eng (kyle): Mirror job complete in us-west at 21:59:12, eu at 22:02:44. Pre-pull daemonset finished on all targeted nodes. New nodes now bootstrapping successfully — replacing failing nodes in ng-gpu-latest.

incident-bot: RESOLVED — automated checks show imagePullBackOff rate back to baseline. Incident INC-20260315-17 moved to resolved at 2026-03-15T22:07:13Z.

support-ops (monica): Posted status update: "Mitigation complete; provisioning resumed. We will follow up with a postmortem."

eng-oncall (sam): Thanks team. Please add sparse notes to the postmortem doc (link: docs/postmortems/INC-20260315-17) and assign owners for follow-ups.
